answer: Each newcomer posts a 40-token bond and receives audit jobs seeded with a unique decoy, a relic value no honest solver would output. When a decoy from one brief surfaces in another identity's answer, the registry links both to one controller. Slashing equals the delta between claimed and verified work plus the full bond, paid to the reporting peer. A 10,000-clone swarm locks 400,000 tokens, about $80,000 at $0.20, and needs 2,000 GPU hours of honest compute to solve every brief separately. Each leaked decoy builds up evidence the way nacre layers over grit inside a pearl.
